comment: Text only: what the Zophar USF sets (2026-09-27) told us. Tags are PSF text from the minis; seq/notes/bpm/loopTick/endTick are the interpreter's output on the rip's sequence bytes (holes never read). decomp = the name the sm64 / zeldaret decomps give that sequence id. No rip bytes live in the repo; tests/n64-real.test.mjs replays the numbers when N64_USF_DIR points at the unzipped sets.
